intent: Show exactly which password policy checks pass while keeping the typed phrase in a normal labelled field.

layout.direction: A focused 448px maximum-width password field with 24px padding, a 48px input/reveal row, three 4px requirement fills and a vertical rule list. Empty policies omit both the meter and rule list.
layout.container: Size to the parent with @container. Keep the root width at 100%, capped to the focused component, with 24px desktop and 16px narrow padding.

typography.label: 20px medium, tight tracking
typography.input: 16px; retain the exact raw string when revealing or concealing

fieldBoundary.requirement: At least 3:1 against the panel in either theme.

motion.entrance: A single opacity and 8px rise over 320ms.
motion.interaction: 250ms requirement fills and native button focus. On live reduced motion, stop the entrance and settle all fills while retaining the field and its focus.
motion.reduced: Remove transforms and layout motion, including active fills or ruler transitions when the preference changes; keep opacity at 120ms or less.

responsive.rules: Wrap long copy; stack secondary details inside narrow containers; keep any horizontal scrolling local and keyboard accessible.

accessibility: Use native buttons and form controls with visible 2px focus rings.
Provide labels, meaningful states and polite feedback where actions update content.
Keep IDs instance-scoped with useId; support multiple instances and empty custom data.
Respect prefers-reduced-motion; no automatic action or navigation.

content.defaults: Use the realistic default content from the source; expose content and collection inputs as typed props.

props.name: value
props.description: Controlled password, never persisted by the component. Without onChange, editing is read-only.

props.name: rules
props.description: Pure named predicates. Defaults count Unicode code points and recognize Unicode letters, numbers, punctuation and symbols. Custom rules run unchanged; empty arrays show no configured requirements.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables the field and reveal control.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Receives each edit for host validation.

props.name: theme
props.description: Surface and ink palette; the demo stage follows the chosen theme.

avoid: Remote images, fake network success or hidden external dependencies.
Decorative status badges, gradients as filler, low-contrast text.
Unlabelled controls, hover-only functionality, overflow at 320px.
contract: Evaluate only the supplied named predicates; the default policy checks length, letters/numbers and a symbol. Do not invent a strength score.
Use native new-password autocomplete. Reveal and conceal keep the exact current phrase and expose a pressed state.
Keep met/not-met text in the rule list and a polite requirement count; an empty policy explicitly reports no configured requirements.
Controlled text waits for the host. A missing writer makes it read-only while reveal stays available; disabled prevents both editing and reveal.
Changing reduced motion must settle active requirement fills without restarting the field or losing its focus.

Count Unicode code points for the sample length rule. Accented and non-Latin letters remain letters; only punctuation or symbols meet the symbol rule. Invisible format characters do not become symbols.
Keep custom policy predicates unchanged and deliver the raw string to the host. Use singular requirement copy for one rule; empty policies retain valid descriptions without blank progress/list space.
